title: Still working track
text: The Tehachapi Loop is not a monument, it is working railroad. BNSF runs about 20 trains a day through it and Union Pacific about 16, which comes to an average of around 36 freight trains a day. The siding on the loop is called Walong, named for a Southern Pacific district roadmaster, W. A. Long.
